decisions.boundary_condition: Treat this as a preference rather than an absolute requirement unless the user explicitly says no layovers for the current trip.
decisions.condition: When searching for outbound or return flights, prioritize nonstop options.
decisions.default_action: Search for and present a nonstop itinerary first.
decisions.exception_condition: If no suitable nonstop flight is available, a one-stop option may be acceptable, but confirm the tradeoff before booking.
decisions.name: Prefer nonstop flights
decisions.rationale: Repeated evidence across three flight requests supports a soft preference for nonstop itineraries. One example explicitly permits at most one stop, so the policy appropriately preserves a one-stop fallback without strengthening the preference into an absolute prohibition on layovers.
